channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Meta recebeu ao menos R$ 1,1 mi em anúncios eleitorais ilegais, diz estudo
item.description: A UOL study found that Meta received over R$1.1 million to promote hundreds of election ads violating both the company's community rules and Brazilian legislation. These paid advertisements, promoted around the elections, breach established norms and laws.

item.title: Como funciona a apuração de votos nas eleições? O caminho até o resultado
item.description: Brazilian election counting does not rely on a single central machine. Each electronic voting device records votes for its section and generates a local result. These results are sent to the Electoral Justice, where they are aggregated to form the final outcome. The process is fast and decentralized, ensuring transparency in vote counting.

item.title: Eleições 2026: o que é ser de direita, esquerda ou centro na política?
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil will be shaped by clear political stances — right, left, and center — influencing proposals across economy, security, health, and education. While there is no fixed classification, labels vary according to national context, issues, and voter perception. Current polarization is likely to intensify ideological battles, directly affecting the electoral landscape.

item.title: Investigação sobre 'Dark Horse' deve ser suspensa se Flávio for eleito
item.description: If elected president, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) would have his Federal Police investigation in the 'Dark Horse' case suspended, according to reports. The investigation points to the senator as Suspect in money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption.

item.title: Nunes Marques vê caminho favorável ao TSE em julgamento sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: The group of ministers closest to Kassio Nunes Marques at the STF expects a favorable ruling in the trial regarding the removal of social media posts linking presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to attempts to dethrone Our Lady of Aparecida. The case involves legal actions to protect the candidate's image. The decision could impact the campaign and freedom of expression on social media during the elections.

item.title: Qual horário de votação no 1º turno? Veja que horas começa e acaba eleição
item.description: Voting for the first round of the 2026 Brazilian elections will take place from 8am to 5pm (Brasília time) on October 4th. In states with different time zones, local times vary, such as 7am in Rondônia, Mato Grosso, and Amazonas, or 9am in Fernando de Noronha. Results tallying begins at 5pm Brasília time.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: qual a chance e o que acontece se a eleição ficar empatada?
item.description: Recent polls show a tight race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for the 2026 presidency. While an exact tie is highly unlikely, Brazilian electoral law provides constitutional criteria to resolve such scenarios, primarily based on total votes and, if needed, a decision by Congress.

item.title: Bets: como o governo reagiu à ameaça de paralisação do Brasileirão
item.description: The Lula administration decided to postpone discussions on the sports betting ban until after the first round of elections, following threats from betting companies and football clubs to paralyze the Brazilian Championship. A meeting between ministers and football representatives was canceled after teams boycotted it, with the strategy being to avoid the issue gaining political traction ahead of the vote.

item.title: Governos querem Estado mais digital, falta o brasileiro ter acesso a ele
item.description: The government plans of the top five candidates converge on digitizing the state but pay little attention to inclusion and effective public access. According to Reglab analysis, despite progress on gov.br, large segments of society — especially lower-income classes, the elderly, and those with low education — face connectivity and usage challenges. There is a clear mismatch between the supply of digital services and the actual conditions for citizens to use them.

item.title: Urnas vão traçar futuro de Moraes; proximidade do primeiro turno reativa tema nos bastidores do STF
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes' investigation regarding ties to Daniel Vorcaro was postponed, but the upcoming 2026 elections bring the issue back to the fore. The minister's fate rests with the vote: the winner will appoint justices, the Attorney General, Federal Police director, and influence any potential Senate impeachment proceedings.

item.title: Terceira via chega à eleição sem empolgar e pressionada por voto útil; especialistas apontam motivos
item.description: Third-way candidates struggle to gain traction in polls, pressured by the 'useful vote' and strong polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Experts cite vote crystallization, candidate oversaturation, and inability to propose coherent alternatives as main obstacles. The dominance of Bolsonarism on the right limits the rise of independent figures.

item.title: Debate na Globo: Tarcísio e Haddad discutem segurança pública e saúde; VÍDEO
item.description: In the TV Globo debate, Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad discussed public security and healthcare, key issues for São Paulo voters. Both criticized alliances with figures linked to the PCC and debated crime indicators and pandemic-era health management.

item.title: Com eleição apertada, Flávio concentra reta final em homens, Sudeste e eleitores de 2 a 5 salários
item.description: As the race tightens, Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign focuses its final stretch on men, the Southeast region, and voters earning 2 to 5 minimum wages. The strategy targets undecided voters and those not yet rejecting the senator, particularly ages 25 to 34. In a simulated runoff, Flávio and Lula tie at 42%, within the margin of error.

item.title: 12% dos brasileiros dizem que Lula é um clone. De onde saiu essa teoria rocambolesca e o que a faz voltar de tempos em tempos?
item.description: The 'Lula clone' theory emerged after the 2022 election, gaining traction through conspiracy videos shared by major influencers. Research shows 12% of Brazilians believe this unfounded narrative. The disinformation resurfaces periodically, fueling doubts about the president's true identity.

item.title: Lula ganha fôlego em pesquisas e deve evitar debate às vésperas do 1º turno
item.description: Lula is expected to skip the TV Globo debate before the first round, aiming to avoid direct confronts with right-wing candidates. His absence is influenced by Flávio Bolsonaro's strategy, who will participate even without Lula, and Lula's improved polling numbers, reaching 39% of voting intentions.

item.title: O tempo fechou para Flávio Bolsonaro a quatro dias das eleições
item.description: The article discusses misinformation and deceptive propaganda in Brazilian elections, highlighting historical cases of rumors and fabrications that influenced electoral outcomes. It mentions Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, focusing on the 2026 elections, and analyzes how misinformation can impact democracy. The text also addresses the importance of power alternation as a fundamental pillar of the democratic regime.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta quarta (30/9)
item.description: Five days before the 2026 first-round elections in São Paulo, candidates compete for victory with varied agendas. Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead the polls, while other contenders also prepare campaign actions.

item.title: Vizinhos do Brasil se aproximam de Trump e desafiam plano regional de Lula
item.description: South American governments are deepening ties with the United States under Trump's influence, challenging Lula's regional integration strategy. The split became evident as 14 countries joined the Shield of the Americas to combat groups labeled as narcoterrorists, a move Brazil declined to participate in.

item.title: Escudo das Américas: o que é a aliança de Trump que Flávio quer aderir
item.description: The Americas Shield, an alliance created by Trump with South American countries, divides the Brazilian candidates. Flávio Bolsonaro supports joining, while Lula keeps distance, citing strategic sovereignty risks.

item.title: Flávio usa fala de Lula sobre "toque" para reduzir desgaste com padroeira
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro leveraged a statement by Lula regarding 'touch' in health exams to divert attention from the controversy surrounding Our Lady of Aparecida. Lula advocated for preventive prostate exams, comparing male reluctance to touch with women's routine gynecological exams. The strategy aims to reduce campaign backlash for the senator on social media.

item.title: Em meio à crise no STF, PL pode sair das urnas com votação recorde no Senado
item.description: Projections by Plano Político, based on 425 polls, suggest the PL may elect 15 new senators, expanding its Senate caucus to 24 lawmakers. The STF crisis could affect the party's performance in Sunday's vote.

item.title: Copernicus: calor armazenado nos oceanos atinge maior nível já registrado
item.description: A study by the European observatory Copernicus reveals that the amount of heat stored in the oceans reached the highest level ever recorded in 2025, with 23 zettajoules—nearly 40 times the total energy consumed by humanity in the same period. The ocean has also become more acidic and is showing impacts such as changes in phytoplankton patterns and Arctic sea ice reduction.

item.title: ‘Eleitores BBB’ definirão o 1º turno das eleições, avalia Marcos Coimbra
item.description: Sociologist Marcos Coimbra states that low-engagement voters ('three Bs') will decide if the October 4 election ends in the first round. Polling shows Lula leading at 44% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 39% of valid votes.

item.title: Confira as agendas dos candidatos à Presidência nesta quarta-feira (30/9)
item.description: Presidential candidates have confirmed public schedules for Wednesday (9/30), including walks, caravans, podcast interviews, and meetings with supporters across multiple states. Lula, Caiado, Cury, Grassi, Hertz Dias, Samara Martins, and Martins listed detailed itineraries; Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema, Renan Santos, and Edmilson Costa did not release agendas.

item.title: Sintonia entre Toffoli com Mendonça no TSE irrita ministros do Supremo
item.description: Justice Dias Toffoli has aligned his votes with those of TSE Vice-President André Mendonça, an alignment that has caused discomfort among some STF justices. This convergence of positions between the two magistrates is seen as a strategic move within the electoral legal landscape.

item.title: Governo vai cobrar bancos para rastrear operações ilegais e apertar cerco contra divulgação de bets nas redes
item.description: The federal government has intensified the crackdown on illegal betting, focusing on financial tracking and content removal on digital platforms. Authorities requested the takedown of thousands of websites and social media profiles, and notified major platforms to halt advertisements. Measures include pressuring financial institutions and setting deadlines for app removals and ad suspensions.

item.title: Bolsonaro pode votar? Entenda o que acontece com presos nas eleições
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro will not be able to vote in the 2026 elections due to the suspension of his political rights after a definitive criminal conviction for the coup plot. Provisional prisoners, such as Daniel Vorcaro, retain the right to vote, as ruled by the TSE, though fewer than 3% of provisional prisoners voted in 2022. The rule distinguishes between prisoners with a final conviction—who lose their political rights—and those awaiting trial, who keep their voting rights.

item.title: Por que Lula não quer ir ao debate da Globo e a estratégia de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is hesitant to attend the Globo debate due to its format, according to reports from allies. The article highlights Lula's reluctance to engage in a format where he would face criticism from other candidates.

item.title: Caso Nossa Senhora faz Lula levar santa ao palanque após criticar mistura de política com religião
item.description: During a rally in Belém, former governor and Senate candidate Helder Barbalho (MDB-PA) presented a statue of Nossa Senhora de Nazaré to President Lula (PT), who displayed it to the audience and was applauded. The next day, in Fortaleza, Lula stated that while he is president, Nossa Senhora Aparecida will be the patron saint of Brazil, reinforcing the link between religion and politics.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad nacionalizam debate com Lava Jato e 'caos na saúde'
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) nationalized the São Paulo gubernatorial debate by referencing the Lava Jato operation and criticizing previous health policies, highlighting disagreements on corruption and public policies. The exchange underscored the polarized tone between the candidates.

item.title: Arrecadação com 'imposto do pecado' vai cair sem bets, e governo terá de compensar com demais setores
item.description: Lula's ban on online betting will reduce tax revenue from the selective tax, requiring fiscal compensation from other sectors, complicating the 2027 tax reform implementation.

item.title: Renan Santos critica uso de Nossa Senhora Aparecida em discursos políticos
item.description: Renan Santos criticized the use of religion in political speeches, particularly the dispute involving Our Lady of Aparecida between the candidates of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. He stated he would never use his faith for electoral purposes and considered the religious instrumentalization 'horrible' and 'humiliating'. He also attacked Supreme Court justices, calling them political agents.

item.title: Flávio e Tarcísio escolhem interior de SP para último ato de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas chose the interior of São Paulo for their final campaign event, with rallies in Santa Bárbara d'Oeste and Americana on Saturday (3). The decision avoids the capital due to logistical constraints and targets regional voters. São Paulo was a strategic focus in the final stretch.

item.title: Tarcísio chama Haddad de Pinóquio em debate ao falar sobre mães atípicas
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas called Fernando Haddad a Pinocchio during a TV Globo debate when discussing policies for atypical mothers. Haddad criticized the governor for allegedly supporting ex-councilman Milton Leite before his arrest. The debate was marked by heated exchanges over public policies and corruption suspicions.

item.title: Amigo de Flávio e R$ 5 bi em bet: focinho, pata e pelo de gato. Será gato?
item.description: Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro and already under investigation for suspected fraud in the INSS, is believed to have wagered R$ 10 billion in online betting in 2023, with at least R$ 5 billion in net transactions. The suspicion of money laundering is under review by the Federal Police, though the source of the funds remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Na Bahia, Lula diz a aliados estar preocupado com crise no STF
item.description: During a rally in Salvador, President Lula expressed concern over the crisis at the Supreme Federal Court and its politicization, without naming any specific ministers. He rejected the possibility of a joint vote for ACM Neto and emphasized concerns about judicial reform. The STF crisis has worsened following messages involving banker Daniel Vorcaro and controversial judicial decisions.

item.title: Nikolas a Lula e Janja: “Canalha é quem foi preso por corrupção”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) responded to criticisms from President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and First Lady Janja Lula, calling them 'scoundrels' and countering the president's statements about medical exams. The exchange of insults occurred after Lula labeled Nikolas a 'scoundrel' and Janja called him a 'bad kid' during campaign rallies.

item.title: Zema condiciona desistência a movimento em bloco e diz que anuncia apoio no 2º turno no domingo
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) says he will not withdraw before the first round but will announce support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round. He rejects pre-election alliance pressures, stressing unity against the PT only after the first round. Zema also celebrates the TSE decision to include him in presidential debates.

item.title: Eleição sem debate
item.description: Lula is likely to skip the TV Globo debate, leaving the first round without a direct confrontation between candidates. The lack of a third front reinforces polarization between pro and anti-PT candidates.

item.title: Assista ao vídeo de Lula sobre câncer de próstata e mulher “tomar toque”
item.description: Lula stated at a rally in Pará that women learn to perform self-exams early, while men resist prostate tests, prompting opposition criticism. He highlighted the first robotic prostate surgery in Northern Brazil and advocated for cancer prevention. His campaign asked the TSE to act against posts by lawmaker Nikolas Ferreira.

item.title: TSE volta atrás e permite post de Erika Hilton sobre Nossa Senhora e Flávio
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça reversed restrictions on a post by lawmaker Erika Hilton (PSol) referencing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and a 2007 bill proposing to revoke the title of Patroness of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida. Mendonça ruled the mention of Flávio as conditional, allowing restoration of the post, but maintained removal of claims directly linking him or his family to proposing or supporting the bill. The decision highlights electoral tensions around religious themes and controversial candidacies.

item.title: Em debate, Haddad usa prisão de Milton Leite para atacar Tarcísio e Nunes
item.description: In a Globo debate, Haddad used Milton Leite's arrest to criticize Tarcísio and Nunes for alleged improper involvement. Tarcísio responded, claiming his relationship with the Leite family was institutional. The debate followed a campaign event involving family members of Leite.

item.title: Haddad questiona Tarcísio sobre apoio a filhos de Milton Leite
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) questioned Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for seeking votes for the children of Milton Leite, former president of the São Paulo City Council, labeling him a 'shadow mayor' and demanding explanations about supporting someone who would be arrested 15 days later.

item.title: TSE manda incluir candidatos do Novo em debates eleitorais
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the inclusion of candidates from the Novo party in the 2026 electoral debates, responding to a request from the party's national directory and benefiting Romeu Zema, Kiko Caputo, and André Marinho.

item.title: Caso Nossa Senhora: a interferência direta no resultado da eleição, segundo advogado eleitoral
item.description: Electoral lawyer Arthur Rollo warns that clashes between the STF and TSE over the Nossa Senhora Aparecida case may impact election outcomes due to divergent single-judge decisions and legal uncertainty. He criticizes 'relator fishing' and internal divisions weakening the TSE's authority.

item.title: Ricardo Salles acompanha Tarcísio em debate da Globo
item.description: Deputy Ricardo Salles, who recently withdrew his Senate candidacy, joined Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) at the TV Glovo debate for São Paulo governor. The delegation included allies André do Prado (PL) and Guilherme Derrite (PP). This was the second and final debate before the first-round vote on Sunday.

item.title: Após depositar R$ 325 mi para apostas, amigo de Flávio pede bloqueio de dinheiro de bet; Justiça nega
item.description: São Paulo Justice denied the freezing of R$145.5 million from betting operator Blaze, in a lawsuit filed by Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro and under investigation for fraud. The amount corresponds to the lawyer's losses on the platform and a moral damages claim he himself requested. The case involves parallel investigations into irregularities in the gaming sector and suspected money laundering.

item.title: Lula critica ACM Neto por autodeclaração de cor e elo com Vorcaro
item.description: Lula criticized ACM Neto over changes to his racial self-declaration and ties to Daniel Vorcaro, rejecting any alliance. The former mayor declared himself white to electoral authorities in 2026, after switching from white to brown in 2022. Lula urged votes for Jeronimo Rodrigues, Jaques Wagner, and Rui Costa.

item.title: Lula ataca Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que única experiência do adversário é com milicianos
item.description: During a campaign event in Salvador, President Lula attacked Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming his only experience is with militia members and money laundering. The statement takes place in a tense electoral context, with both candidates competing for recognition and votes in the 2026 elections.

item.title: O que indica crescimento de petista em pesquisa em estado chave das eleições, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: The growth of Patrus Ananias (PT) in the Minas Gerais race reflects the consolidation of the PT candidacy among left-wing voters. According to a Quaest intelligence director, the increase is due to the electorate identifying the PT and Lula candidate. The trend also reveals a weakening of Alexandre Kalil, who trails behind leaders like Cleitinho Azevedo and Patrus in the polls.
